summary: Staggered long-lived prefetch streams causing sustained slot hogging and p50 throughput sag in dedicated pool
description:
Issue summary:
- Customer (CleverAI Labs, dedicated) reported a sustained p50 throughput degradation across their reserved pool (pool-id: reserved-pool-42) during evening commit window. The pattern coincided with many long-lived prefetch/keepalive streams from a small set of customer processes.

Impact:
- P50 increased by ~30% and p95 by ~12% for the customer's batched routes between 18:00-22:30 UTC on 2026-03-13. Latency increases caused timeouts for a small percentage of critical inference requests and triggered failover to a cheaper model variant. No data loss reported.

Environment:
- Dedicated capacity: reserved-pool-42 (prod-us-east)
- Models: redwood-compat-v1 and gptj-7b variants
- Autoscaler: predictive window enabled; composite metrics include slot-utilization and heartbeat-rates

Steps to reproduce:
1) Customer ramps a mixture of short inference streams and long-lived prefetching streams (persisting >10m).
2) Observe slot occupancy in pool (multiple slots appear held by the long-lived streams even when idle).
3) Autoscaler does not provision in time because heartbeat sampling shows steady but low active throughput, misclassifying idle-prefetchers as active.
4) Incoming burst from short streams experience queueing and p50 increases.

Logs / metrics attached:
- sample scheduler logs: 
  [2026-03-13T18:05:12Z] scheduler: slot-assign reserved-pool-42 tenant=cleverai process=proc-12 assigned gpu=gpua-3
  [2026-03-13T18:05:13Z] sidecar-prefetch: keepalive start stream_id=sf-82 duration_est=3600 tenant=cleverai
  [2026-03-13T18:20:02Z] autoscaler: window_eval(pool=reserved-pool-42) observed_slot_util=0.78 predicted_need=0.0
- metric snapshots: p50_routes: baseline 120ms -> 156ms (peak), gpu_utilization averaged 73% but NVLINK-io waits increased; slot_held_count for tenant cleverai jumped from 3 -> 28 in 30m

Additional context:
- This pattern is not a single noisy tenant hog (tenant concurrency is modest) but many staggered long-lived prefetch streams from a handful of processes that never fully release slots.
comments: [2026-03-13 18:45] Anika Patel (Support): Customer filed initial report. Provided request IDs and example timestamps. Escalated to SRE because this impacts reserved throughput and appears capacity-related.

[2026-03-13 19:12] Marcus Liu (SRE): Observed slot_held_count spike. Early hypothesis: sidecar prefetch logic opens persistent streams and doesn't release slot back to pool on idle due to mismatch in idle_timeout config. Reproduced a similar pattern in staging with synthetic prefetchers.

[2026-03-13 20:03] Priya Rao (Runtime Eng): Looked at autoscaler telemetry; predictive model suppressed scale-up because historical duty cycle looked steady. Telemetry gap: we did not account for long-lived streams that hold slots with near-zero CPU but non-zero heartbeat cadence. Filed PR to adjust heartbeats weight (see related PR).

[2026-03-13 21:15] Customer (CleverAI Labs - devops@cleverai.com): We recently deployed a new prefetch worker releasing after 60s, but rolled back to a different replica that keeps it alive. We'll attempt to throttle on our side but need coordination if a runtime change is recommended.

[2026-03-14 09:30] Marcus Liu (SRE): Applied temporary tenant-level throttle (rate-limit long-lived streams) for cleverai tenant; observed p50 drop back toward baseline within 12 minutes. Planning controlled runtime-side mitigation today.
[2026-03-14 12:00] Anika Patel (Support): Customer confirmed improvement; monitoring and will report if regressions return.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Sidecar prefetches hold GPU slot lease while idle. Idle slot detection currently uses CPU-based heuristics which don't trigger for prefetchers that perform infrequent KV cache requests.
Hypothesis 2: Autoscaler's predictive component underweights slot-hold time and over-relies on task-throughput signals; scale-up suppressed during steady prefetch load.

Finding: Slot_held_count correlated strongly with number of active prefetch streams (r=0.86). NVLink IO wait and PCIe latency increased during the spike, indicating contention beyond simple compute load.
Repro: Created staging harness that opened 40 staggered prefetch streams across 5 processes; reproduced p50 sag and autoscaler non-action.
resolution: Workaround (applied 2026-03-14 09:25 UTC): Tenant-level throttle limiting concurrent prefetch streams to 6 for CleverAI Labs. This reduced slot_held_count and restored p50 toward baseline.

Short-term fix (deployed 2026-03-14 14:00 UTC): Autoscaler patch merged to incorporate 'slot_held_time' as a weighted signal in predictive model (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/4321). Deployed to canary nodes in prod-us-east.
Runtime change (rolling 2026-03-15): Add explicit idle-release path in sidecar-prefetch when stream bandwidth < 0.5 req/min for > 90s; will gate behind feature flag for dedicated pools.

Follow-ups: 1) Add metric alert for slot_held_count growth per-tenant (SLO guardrail). 2) Runbook update to include prefetch throttling guidance for customers. 3) Post-incident review scheduled with customer and runtime team to define best practices for prefetch design.
Status: Mitigations in prod canary and tenant throttle active; monitoring for regression.
